items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: he’s playing with us — us being a kind of put together rhythm section.

ctx.x: Well great, I hope I see you at Pearl’s maybe before we leave.

Yeah I’m trying to think, I’ll be there tonight with a saxophone player from L.A., a guy named Bruce Escovitz, who happens to be teaching at the Stanford Jazz Workshop. I saw him yesterday. And so he’s playing with us — us being a kind of put together rhythm section. And then the weekend, I don’t know who’s there this weekend, but there’s always good music there. And talk to the guy that runs the joint, Sonny Buxton, a very interesting man. He’s got his own radio show on Saturdays. You might catch him Saturday…
Great. All right well thanks for your time today.
